_comment: Unicode ranges the self-hosted fonts in this folder are subset to by scripts/fonts/build-fonts.py. Every family gets "core": printable ASCII, NBSP, guillemets, the multiplication sign, Arabic letters, harakat, digits and Quranic marks, joiners and direction marks, dashes, the ellipsis, the dotted circle, the Quran brackets, and the Allah and salawat ligatures. A family listed under "extra" also gets those ranges: the UI face keeps the keyboard letters and digits people may type into search. The build writes each file's resulting code points to cmap.json, and src/lib/athkar/font-coverage.test.ts proves every character the site renders is in the files that render it.
